# macOS fixtures

Stopgap fixtures written on 2026-11-21 from the documented shape of `system_profiler -json` and
`ioreg -a -r -c AppleSmartBattery` output, not recorded on a Mac. Replace them with recordings
from the team's MacBook (feature 007 T-005, T-011), with the real identifiers replaced by
`PLANTED-…` values. Every file plants serial numbers, UUIDs and volume names that the payload must
never contain.
